items.q: the only other man that I learned -- well, several people I've learned a lot from -- was Lenny Hayton

ctx.x: Yes, he was. I don't think there's anyone who's ever been associated with him that didn't learn a lot from him.
That's right. I'll tell you, the only other man that I learned -- well, several people I've learned a lot from -- was Lenny Hayton, Lena Horne's husband.
In what way was Lenny helpful?
